beats.label: S1 · UGIS
beats.text: Maya learns Brandt and Dustin faked their crushes on her — a prank crowning her UGIS, Ugliest Girl in School. She confronts Brandt without swinging.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Maya's core wound and Brandt as the boy whose dance confession will drive the S2 opener.

beats.label: S1 · Ojiichan is watching
beats.text: Maya discovers masturbation and lets it fill her days. Her mother's warning that Ojiichan is always watching turns the discovery into private shame.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The habit and the shame around her body come back late in S2 when Ume walks in on her.

beats.label: S1 · Posh
beats.text: Cast as Posh Spice then told she can't be, Maya absorbs racist taunts while Anna, too scared for her reputation, fails to step in. A rift opens.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fixes Maya as the show's outsider and marks Anna's pattern of freezing when social cost is real.

beats.label: S1 · Flymiamibro22
beats.text: In an AIM singles chatroom Maya begins flirting with a stranger, Flymiamibro22. He becomes her one private romance while everything at school hurts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the mystery whose reveal at the dance — Sam — hijacks the last beat of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Anna and Brendan
beats.text: Anna's first romance is with awkward Brendan. It builds through the fall concert, peaks at a Wild Things kiss, and she ends it when tension outweighs thrill.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Brendan is the boyfriend Maya has to confront on Anna's behalf at the S2 pool party.

beats.label: S1 · Home falls apart
beats.text: Anna is sent to Maya's while her parents attend a marriage retreat that confirms the split. Maya gets her first period; jealousy and grief blow the friendship open.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The divorce this reveals is the state Anna lives inside for all of S2.

beats.label: S1 · Dance
beats.text: At the fall dance they reconcile. Brandt admits his cruel crush on Maya was real, and Sam confesses he was Flymiamibro22 the whole time — she is not flattered.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The two revelations Maya carries out of the dance are exactly what S2 opens trying to defuse.

cliffhanger.text: Friendship patched at the dance — but the boys have detonated. Sam is her secret AIM crush, Brandt's cruelty was a crush too, and Anna's home is splitting in half.
questions: Can Maya forgive Sam for hiding as Flymiamibro22, or does the lie outweigh what he now wants?
What does Anna do when the divorce is real and she has to pick a parent?
Was Brandt's dance confession the start of something, or just another swerve?

characters.name: Maya Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Thirteen, Japanese-American, cast as UGIS on day one and ending the year as an outsider with a private, growing crush on her rival Sam.

characters.name: Anna Kone
characters.line: Maya's best friend, whose seventh grade is shaped less by school than by her parents' quiet collapse into divorce.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: Maya's neighbour and musical rival — and the boy behind Flymiamibro22, a fact he finally told her at the dance.

characters.name: Brandt
characters.line: Popular boy who ran the UGIS prank, then admitted at the dance that his crush on Maya was real.

characters.name: Brendan
characters.line: Anna's awkward first boyfriend, dumped after Wild Things when the physical stuff felt worse than none of it.

characters.name: Curtis Kone
characters.line: Anna's father — one half of the marriage that has now openly ended.

characters.name: Yuki Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Maya's Japanese mother, the one who told her Ojiichan is always watching.

characters.name: Shuji Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Maya's older brother — fight instructor, phone-owning golden child of the house.

beats.label: S2 · Pool party
beats.text: At Alex's pool party they try to unwind the dance mess with Sam, Brendan and Brandt, but only tangle it further. Word spreads that they are desperate sluts.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pool party is exit velocity from S1's revelations, and the 'sluts' label sets the social floor for the year.

beats.label: S2 · Wrestling
beats.text: Joining wrestling to be near Brandt, the girls quit after overhearing the boys' cruelty. Sam drifts into the popular crowd and stops answering his real friends.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is the version of Sam Maya deals with all season — the boy who chose the room she can't get into.

beats.label: S2 · Witches
beats.text: Anna's parents fight until she flees to the woods. She and Maya invent witch powers to feel in control — until Brandt uses one to tell Maya he hates her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Wiccany game is Anna coping with a home coming apart in real time; Brandt's line closes the door S1 left open.

beats.label: S2 · Maura
beats.text: Rich, manipulative Maura buys them the 'Best Best Friends' title, then hosts a sleepover that isolates Maya. Her constant boasting turns out to be lies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The first outsider let inside the friendship, and the template for how they get burned when they let one in.

beats.label: S2 · Play
beats.text: Opposite Gabe in the school play, Maya panics when he ducks the kiss and he ends things — he is realising he's gay. Anna's dad tells her he is moving out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Curtis officially moves out here, and Gabe is another boy who wanted Maya without wanting her.

beats.label: S2 · Florida
beats.text: Curtis drives the girls to Florida, where boys stand them up and Anna drinks herself into a rough confrontation with her dad. Feeling ugly starts to feel like fact.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This is where the season's body-image dread stops being a joke and lodges, and where Curtis stops being the fun parent.

beats.label: S2 · Home
beats.text: They meet older boys Derrick and Steve. Maya gives a hated first blowjob, Derrick dumps her and Anna dumps Steve, and Sam gives Maya her first kiss.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sam finally becomes a real thing, and Shuji quietly becomes the next problem the friendship has to survive.

cliffhanger.text: The older-boyfriend experiment collapsed in a single night at Derrick's. Sam has become the boy Maya kissed for real, and Shuji has become the boy Anna cannot stop watching.
questions: Does Maya want Sam back now the AIM lie is stale and the kiss is fresh?
What happens when Anna's crush on Maya's older brother stops staying in her head?
With Curtis moved out, which parent does Anna choose to live with?

characters.name: Maya Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Still the outsider, still in love with Sam — and now the girl who gave a first blowjob she hated and took a first kiss she wanted.

characters.name: Anna Kone
characters.line: Living her parents' divorce in real time, and ending the season with a quiet, complicated crush on Maya's older brother.

characters.name: Sam
characters.line: Spent the year drifting into Brandt's popular crowd, then ended it by kissing Maya — the only piece of him she wanted.

characters.name: Shuji Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Maya's older brother — the harmless family fixture Anna suddenly cannot stop looking at.

characters.name: Curtis Kone
characters.line: Anna's dad, who moved out mid-season and took the girls to Florida; still trying, awkwardly, to be the fun parent.

characters.name: Yuki Ishii-Peters
characters.line: Maya's mother, whose reunion this year with her ex-husband reminded her how much she loves the children she has.
